messages:
jess: Quick sync — we need to lock vendor roadmap windows for joint announce and marketplace onramp (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi). Proposed time Fri 10am PT. Who can join? Also need embargo handoff plan + fallback routing if H200 slips.
kyle: I can join. Nvidia said H200 shipment ETA is still TBC. We should confirm firmware microcode freeze date.
nina: SI note — Gaudi integration tests require distro image (rootfs + kernel) by 2026-04-15. If we don't get it, we can run Gaudi canary with quantized model only in eu-west.
ricardo: From marketplace ops: listing needs SKU tags, driver bundle, and attestations. Target listing cutoff = 2026-04-20.
jess: @ricardo can you map listing cutoff to announce cadence? Also need to decide press embargo windows — prefer two-week buffer.
kyle: Suggest fallback: if H200 slips, route workload to B200 or H100 depending on latency tier. We'll need perf profiles for H100 vs B200 for our model suites.
hw_partner_bot: vendor_eta_table (generated):
```
vendor,model,eta,firmware_freeze
NVIDIA,H100,2026-04-10,2026-03-25
NVIDIA,H200,2026-05-05 (tent),2026-04-01
AMD,MI300,2026-04-22,2026-03-30
Habana,Gaudi,2026-04-18,2026-03-28
```
nina: That's helpful. For SI validation we need kernel + driver + sample container. I'll post checklist: <https://redwood-internal/tools/si-goldens|SI golden checklist>
ricardo: Marketplace requires compute profile JSON and power/thermal slot info. small example:
```
{
 "sku": "h200-48g",
 "power_w": "450",
 "max_seq": "2048"
}
```
kyle: Also flagging region availability: NA + EU first wave, APAC in wave 2 (depends on partner shipping).
jess: Ok plan:
1) Wed: finalize embargo windows + press ops ask
2) Thu: get vendor firmware freeze confirmations
3) Fri 10am PT: roadmap sync (calendar invite sent)
4) Post-meet: publish marketplace gating matrix + SI dryrun schedule

Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if that works?
nina: :thumbsup:
ricardo: :thumbsup:
kyle: :thumbsup:
jess: Thanks — adding follow-ups to the invite. @hw_partner_bot please ping vendors for final microcode freeze confirmations by EOD Tue.
hw_partner_bot: OK — scheduled pings to NVIDIA/AMD/Habana for firmware confirmation (runs Tue 18:00 UTC). Will post updates in this thread.
